attributes.name: appearance
attributes.description: Sets the component's colors for the background it sits on. Use `inverse` on dark backgrounds and `default` on light ones.

attributes.name: autofocus
attributes.description: Moves keyboard focus to the button when the page loads. Use sparingly: moving focus without warning can disorient keyboard and screen reader users.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Turns the button off. A disabled button is shown in a muted style and can't be clicked or reached with the keyboard.

attributes.name: fluid
attributes.description: Stretches the button to fill the full width of its container.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows a loading indicator in place of the label and blocks clicks until it's turned off. The button keeps its width, so the layout doesn't shift. Use the `ariaLabel.loading` slot to tell screen reader users what's happening.

attributes.name: shape
attributes.description: Sets the button's shape. Use `rounded` (the default) or `pill` for buttons with a text label, and `circle` or `square` for an icon (an ``, an ``) or short text, such as a count. When an icon is slotted, `circle` and `square` buttons show only the icon and visually hide any text beside it, so they need an accessible name from the `ariaLabel` slot or the `aria-label` attribute unless that hidden text says what the button does.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the button's size, from `xs` (smallest) to `xl` (largest). Size controls the button's height, padding, and label text size.

attributes.name: static
attributes.description: Displays the button's styling without any button behavior. A static button can't be focused, doesn't submit a native `<form>`, and isn't announced as a button by screen readers. When the button sits inside another clickable element, such as a linked card, use a static button. Give that element an accessible name, because a name set on a static button isn't reliably read.

attributes.name: tindex
attributes.description: Sets the button's position in the keyboard tab order (the inner element's `tabindex`). Use `-1` to remove the button from the tab order. Ignored when `static` is set.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Sets the tooltip text the browser shows when a mouse pointer rests on the button, such as more detail about what the button does (the `title` attribute). Keyboard and touch users never see it, so don't use it for essential information.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Sets what the button does in a form. `submit` submits the form the button is placed in, whether it's a native `<form>` or an `<auro-form>`, and `reset` resets the fields of an `<auro-form>` but has no effect in a native `<form>`. When the button runs its own action, leave it unset or use `button`.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Sets the button's visual emphasis. Use `primary` for the single most important action in a view, `secondary` for supporting actions, and `tertiary`, `ghost`, or `flat` for progressively quieter actions. `flat` shows only the label, with no background or border. A flat button with a `rounded` or `pill` shape doesn't currently show a focus ring, so use `flat` only with `circle` or `square`.

attributes.name: loadingtext
attributes.description: Deprecated: Use `slot="ariaLabel.loading"` instead. Sets the text screen readers announce while the button is loading.

attributes.name: ondark
attributes.description: Deprecated: Use `appearance="inverse"` instead. Switches the component to colors designed for dark backgrounds.

attributes.name: tabindex
attributes.description: Deprecated: Use `tIndex` instead. Sets the button's position in the keyboard tab order. Set it as a property, with a leading `.` in Lit templates, because a `tabindex` attribute on the host element can add a second tab stop.

slots.name: (default)
slots.description: The button's visible label: text, an icon (an ``, an ``), or both. Set `aria-hidden="true"` on a slotted ``, so screen readers skip it and read only the button's name. In `circle` and `square` buttons, an icon wrapped in another element still counts as the icon, but only an icon slotted directly is sized to the icon size.

slots.name: ariaLabel
slots.description: Text read by screen readers in place of the visible label, for example "Save to favorites". Needed when a `circle` or `square` button shows only an icon or a count, unless the host has an `aria-label` or text visually hidden beside the icon already says what the button does. Without it, screen readers read the host's `aria-label`, or the visible label if there's none.

slots.name: ariaLabel.loading
slots.description: Text read by screen readers in place of the visible label while the button is loading, for example "Saving your changes". Defaults to "Loading...".
